title: crossopetalum pallens
intro: Crossopetalum pallens, commonly known as the "White Leaf Caper" or "Caper", is a plant species in the family Celastraceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
